title: Tier 5's first research
lines: In The Works, tier 5 has its first 3 research: Felling, A deep culvert and Wide mouths.
Felling a redwood now needs Felling. The first costs 1,000 Coins. Each one after costs half as much again, rounded down to a whole 100. Redwoods you felled before count.

more.head: Tunnels
points: With A deep culvert, a tunnel passes under up to 12 tiles, up from 5. Each tile beyond 5 adds 2 Coins to its price at grade 1, 6 at grade 2 and 16 at grade 3.
With Wide mouths, a tunnel takes items in from the left and right of its way in, as well as from behind.

more.head: Also
points: Felling a redwood cannot be undone, and its Coins do not come back.
